If "Lucky 7 Multiplier" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2771.headline: Tickets sell, top prizes remain

2772.body:
"Electric 10s" has fewer top prizes left. The count changed when one top prize of $30,000 was claimed two weeks ago. Unsold tickets still hold five of the original six. Check the top prize count first when you compare scratchers.

The table below shows the full count for "Electric 10s", with every prize level included.
2772.headline: A top prize was just claimed

2773.body:
"Sugar Skull Cash" is down to one top prize after a $100,000 winner was claimed in the latest numbers. The game started with four top prizes. Know that before you buy, because a change in top prizes changes the whole game.

Everything above about "Sugar Skull Cash" comes from the Texas Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2773.headline: A player won a top prize

2774.body:
"The Price is Right™" is new from the Texas Lottery. It is a $10 game with four top prizes of $250,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

The numbers for "The Price is Right™" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2774.headline: A new game is here
